# Milink

> Milink (Milink Digital Agency) is a web design and development studio based in the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada. It designs and builds custom, mobile-friendly websites and online stores for small and local businesses in Toronto and the GTA, and works remotely with businesses outside the GTA.

Contact: info@milink.ca · +1 (437) 600-3139 · https://milink.ca/contact · Instagram @milink.ca

## Services

- [Web design & development](https://milink.ca/services/web-design): custom business websites, built mobile-first, with on-page SEO.
- [E-commerce development](https://milink.ca/services/ecommerce-development): Shopify and WordPress/WooCommerce stores, product pages, checkout and payments.
- [SEO services](https://milink.ca/services/seo-services): technical fixes, page titles, descriptions, headings, structured data and sitemaps.
- [Website maintenance](https://milink.ca/services/website-maintenance): updates, fixes and ongoing support.
- [Branding](https://milink.ca/services/branding): brand identity for small businesses.
- [UI/UX design](https://milink.ca/services/ui-ux-design): interface and user-experience design.
- [Web design in Toronto](https://milink.ca/web-design-toronto): the Toronto/GTA service page.

## Pricing (CAD)

- Essential: from $399. A custom one-page website with an enquiry form, mobile-friendly layout, essential on-page SEO and one refinement round. Client supplies final text, logo and imagery.
- Professional: from $699. Up to five custom pages (services, work, contact), calls to action, essential SEO across core pages, one refinement round.
- E-commerce & Custom: custom quote. Shopify or WooCommerce store, checkout and payments, optional booking, integrations or multilingual support.
- Details: https://milink.ca/pricing
